title: mailparse for RFC 2047 decoding is correct choice
description: Deleting decode_rfc2047 in favour of mailparse::get_value() is correct: mailparse handles RFC 2047 §6.2 whitespace-between-encoded-words rule (ignored whitespace) that the hand-rolled impl missed, uses the charset crate for correct multi-charset decoding, and reduces this codebase's surface area. A contributor suggesting 'bring back the hand-rolled version to avoid the dependency' would be wrong — the hand-rolled version had a spec gap.
